hero.prompt:
Casting (required): fair-skinned Indian woman only. Light wheatish to fair North Indian / urban Indian complexion. Do not use deep brown, dark, or heavily tanned skin.

International Women's Day 2027 warm celebration hero. A close-up lifestyle photograph of a smiling fair-skinned Indian woman at home by a sunny window, gently holding a handwritten card. On her finger she wears the identical ring shown in the reference images (@img1, @img2, @img3, @img4) naturally. The Le Sommet Ring must be in sharp focus, 100% accurate, identical in rose gold band, diamond accents and proportions, with zero distortion, rendered at natural product scale, sitting into the finger with soft contact shadows. Soft morning window light. This ring is the single and only piece of jewelry in the entire image. No floating overlays, cutouts, or giant product diagrams. Keep the design of these jewelries accurate and do not change it's design. Jewelleries in focus. Hyperrealistic jewelry photography image. Avoid: any other jewelry, extra necklaces, extra rings, extra bracelets, distorted hands, floating overlays, graphic drawings, cutouts, product diagrams, oversized jewelry, dark skin. Do not distort or hallucinate the jewelries.
hero.alt: International Women's Day 2027 hero featuring The Le Sommet Ring
